name: Hifuu Fragment
source:
The era of science.

A future where “Hiroshige,” a completely underground bullet train that goes between the capital city of Kyoto and Tokyo in 53 minutes, is currently in service.

And where Maribel Hearn and Renko Usami have yet to meet.

[from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/07/hifuu-fragment-for-steam-launches-july-17]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
科学的时代。

在这个未来，连接首都京都与东京、全程仅需53分钟的全地下新干线“广重”已经通车。

而玛艾露贝莉·赫恩与宇佐见莲子，尚未相识。

[摘自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/07/hifuu-fragment-for-steam-launches-july-17]Gematsu[/url]]
